questions.question: Explain two ways the local church serves the community.

points.text: 1) Food banks — many churches run food banks that provide emergency food supplies to people in poverty. The Trussell Trust, a Christian charity, runs over 1,200 food banks. questions.question: "The Church should focus on worship, not social action." Evaluate this statement.

points.text: Some Christians argue the Church's primary role is worship and spiritual guidance — social action is the government's job. However, Jesus himself healed the sick, fed the hungry and cared for the outcast. The Parable of the Good Samaritan teaches that loving your neighbour requires practical action.
